curation.note: Origami/pleated dress on a mannequin in a lit shop window at night, photographed through glass. Unusually valuable: it satisfies store_display, low_light AND the reflection/mirror stratum at once — the mirror-reversed VICTORIA'S SECRET signage is proof it is a reflection. Material left unknown: it reads as folded paper or coated fabric and guessing would be fabrication.
